description: This file defines the EmployeeSubordinateModel class, representing a data model for employee subordinates in the OrangeHRM system. It serializes information about an employee's subordinate and reporting method, using traits and annotations to facilitate API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing subordinate employee data for API responses, encapsulating subordinate information and reporting method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReportTo entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
